statements.impact_statement: Codex reviewed Trivy 0.76.1 at e713f67f7d54decdcd9b3132c9751833dcced698 on 2026-10-28. The vulnerable RSA JWK parser is reached through configured SPIFFE/JWK credential loading. Code Polishy invokes only version, anonymous database download over go-containerregistry/net/http, and local archive scans. These operations do not select gRPC/xDS SPIFFE credentials or Sigstore OIDC token flows. Scanner containers receive no caller credentials, bootstrap configuration, trust-bundle files or environment; target archives are analyzed as data. The image-configuration analyzer's OPA JWT built-ins use a separate JWK implementation. No enabled input reaches go-jose's RSA private-key validation. Reassess by 2026-11-13 UTC and whenever the scanner image, invocation, mounts, environment, transport or advisory changes. Evidence: https://github.com/riteofstring/code-polishy/blob/main/docs/design/trivy-scanner-assessments.md

evidence: Reviewed scanner execution-path evidence: https://github.com/riteofstring/code-polishy/blob/8ff4d813186149c44143d6b9379d1bcf0d40832d/docs/design/trivy-scanner-assessments.md#cve-2026-116587-rsa-jwk-parsing . Assessment binds this exact image and code-polishy-trivy/v1.
